name: code-block
title: Code block
description: A block of code with a copy button.
a11y: The code is a pre/code element; the region has an accessible name.
The copy button is announced as "Copy code" and confirms with a polite live message.
A listing that scrolls becomes a focusable group named "<title>, scrollable" so the keyboard can scroll it; one that fits is not a tab stop.

props.name: code
props.description: The text to show and to copy. Rendered as text with coloured spans, never as HTML.

props.name: title
props.description: A file name (`button.tsx`) or label (`bash`) shown in the header. Also names the region and picks the language.

props.name: language
props.description: Syntax colouring: `tsx`, `ts`, `jsx`, `js`, `css`, `html`, `bash`, `json` or `text`. Default: guessed from `title`, else `text`.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Number each line. Use for longer listings, not one-line commands.
